item.title: Nigeria's Reforms Got the Numbers Right. Why Haven't Nigerians Felt It Yet?
item.description: Nigeria's reforms have lifted growth, slowed inflation, rebuilt reserves and raised government revenue. Yet about 140 million Nigerians are poor, and wages buy less than they did. This piece explains why ordinary citizens have not felt the gains, where the money went, and what the January 2027 election should decide.
